Have a question?

Questions are welcome.

If something you saw, heard, or experienced today left you wondering why Orthodox Christians do what we do, ask us. You do not need to know the right terminology, and there is no question so basic that it is not worth asking.

The route that works today

The parish office is open Tuesday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. Email office@ntgoc.org or call (540) 548-2665. If what you need is a conversation with Fr. John, the office will arrange it.
